class BIT:
    def __init__(self, n):
        self.n = n
        self.bit = [0] * (n + 1)

    def update(self, i, val):
        while i <= self.n:
            self.bit[i] += val
            i += i & -i

    def query(self, i):
        res = 0
        while i > 0:
            res += self.bit[i]
            i -= i & -i
        return res
